owner: Marketing Manager, AdVantage Retail Pvt. Ltd.
note: Knowledge source for the Guardrail agent. The agent reads these rules at run time; they are deliberately NOT hard-coded in the agent, so a rule change (TC16) takes effect without touching any code.

hard_limits.rationale: No channel may be starved below 15% (keeps learning signal and brand presence alive) or exceed 55% (concentration risk). A single week may not move any channel by more than 15 percentage points, so one bad proposal cannot swing the whole budget.

approval.rationale: Shifts of 5 pp or less on clean data are small, capped and fully auditable, so the agent may act and report. Anything larger, or anything resting on a flagged or incomplete week, is signed off by the accountable human. A trim only counts as a trim once it moves a channel by at least material_trim_pp - otherwise rounding-level corrections would send every cycle to the manager and straight-through processing could never be above zero.

brand_rules.description: Meta share capped at 40% while a brand-safety review is open.
Amazon Ads share capped at 50% to protect direct-to-site customer ownership.
Google share floor of 20% during the festive window to defend branded search.

anomaly_thresholds.rationale: A fixed percentage on its own is not enough. Channel performance rotates with season, creative fatigue and competitor bidding, so a 30% move against a trailing average is ordinary for a volatile channel and alarming for a stable one. A flag therefore requires the move to be BOTH larger than the fixed percentage AND more than volatility_z standard deviations away from that channel's own recent behaviour. Without the second test the detector flagged half the weeks in the year, which in practice means a manager stops reading the alerts.

degraded_mode.trigger: missing or late data feed for any channel
degraded_mode.rationale: On stale data the agent is less certain, so it is allowed to move only half as far.
